annotations.title: Loan limits for every county in a state

description: One state or territory's current-year FHA and conforming loan limits for 2, 3 and 4 units, county by county, with how many counties sit at the FHA floor and the highest FHA limits. Sort by name or by the FHA limit for a unit count; filter to high-cost counties; page with limit and offset.

high_cost_only.description: Only counties whose FHA limit is above the national floor.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. FL.

units.description: Unit count the FHA sort uses.
